a.lede: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has signed a bill that effectively bans the sale of toys with built-in AI chatbots within the state over concerns about what they might say to kids.
a.title: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signs ban on AI chatbot toys backed by $15,000 daily fines

b.lede: New York governor Kathy Hochul has signed into law a five-year ban on the sale of AI chatbot toys.
b.title: New York state bans AI chatbot toys for kids
